description: This is the Cover Plate that seals the pump casing opening for maintenance access while providing structural support and preventing debris entry.
This is the Discharge Nozzle that directs fluid flow out of the pump at a controlled velocity and pressure for efficient system performance.
This is the Impeller which rotates to increase pressure and flow rate of fluid within the centrifugal pump by imparting centrifugal force to the fluid.
This is the Pipe Extension which connects to the pump outlet to direct fluid flow to the desired location with minimal pressure drop.
This is the Shaft that transmits rotational motion and torque within the centrifugal pump to drive the impeller and generate fluid flow.
